name: Exp_Rj_SlidingRangeRj_Digit_System_Tm_Plus
summary: This EA trades breakout signals generated by the Sliding Range Rj Digit System indicator, entering positions when price breaks out of a dynamically sliding range. It incorporates a time filter (Tm) to restrict trading to specific sessions and a Plus module for enhanced entry/exit management, combining range-breakout logic with session-based trade filtering.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Sliding Range Rj Digit System指标产生的突破信号进行交易，当价格突破动态滑动区间时入场。它集成了时间过滤器(Tm)限制交易时段，并带有Plus增强模块优化入场和出场管理，将区间突破逻辑与时段过滤相结合。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于滑动区间突破，通过Sliding Range Rj Digit System指标动态计算价格波动的上下轨区间。当价格突破该区间的上轨时开多单，突破下轨时开空单，属于典型的区间突破策略。入场条件依赖指标信号触发，同时结合Tm时间过滤模块，仅在用户指定的交易时段内允许开仓，避免非活跃时段的虚假突破。出场条件包括固定的止盈止损设置，以及Plus模块提供的移动止损或追踪出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式，默认参数允许用户灵活调整。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数设置，但缺乏动态仓位调整或基于ATR的自适应止损机制，整体风控依赖于用户正确设置参数。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a sliding range breakout, using the Sliding Range Rj Digit System indicator to dynamically calculate upper and lower bands of price fluctuation. When price breaks above the upper band, a buy order is placed; when it breaks below the lower band, a sell order is opened, following a classic range breakout approach. Entry conditions rely on the indicator signal trigger, combined with the Tm time filter module that only allows trading during user-specified sessions, avoiding false breakouts during inactive market periods. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss settings, along with trailing stop or enhanced exit mechanisms provided by the Plus module. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or balance-based lot calculation, with default parameters allowing flexible user adjustment. Money management relies on user-configured stop-loss and take-profit parameters, but lacks dynamic position sizing or ATR-based adaptive stop mechanisms, leaving overall risk control dependent on proper parameter configuration by the user.

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (used when MMRec disabled)

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, typically set at gap close

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 集成时间过滤器避免非活跃时段虚假突破，减少无效交易
滑动区间动态调整适应市场波动变化，比固定区间更灵活
Plus模块提供增强的出场管理，包括追踪止损功能
参数化程度高，用户可根据不同品种和周期灵活调整
pros_en: Integrated time filter avoids false breakouts during inactive sessions, reducing ineffective trades
Sliding range dynamically adapts to market volatility changes, more flexible than fixed ranges
Plus module provides enhanced exit management including trailing stop functionality
Highly parameterized allowing users to flexibly adjust for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 缺乏动态仓位管理机制，未根据市场波动率(ATR)自适应调整止损
突破策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
未内置点差过滤，在点差较大的品种上可能在不利价格入场
依赖单一指标信号，缺乏多维度确认增加信号可靠性
cons_en: Lacks dynamic position sizing mechanism without ATR-based adaptive stop-loss adjustment
Breakout strategy prone to frequent false signals in ranging/choppy markets leading to consecutive losses
No built-in spread filter, potentially entering at unfavorable prices on high-spread instruments
Relies on single indicator signal without multi-dimensional confirmation to increase signal reliability
improvements: 增加ATR自适应止损机制，根据市场波动率动态调整止损距离和仓位大小
添加多时间框架确认和点差过滤，减少虚假突破交易并改善入场质量
improvements_en: Add ATR-based adaptive stop-loss mechanism to dynamically adjust stop distance and position size based on market volatility
Add multi-timeframe confirmation and spread filter to reduce false breakout trades and improve entry quality

risk_points: 突破策略在震荡市中容易连续触发止损造成资金回撤
缺乏点差过滤可能在流动性低的时段以较大滑点入场
risk_points_en: Breakout strategy prone to consecutive stop-loss triggers in choppy markets causing drawdowns
Lack of spread filter may result in entries with significant slippage during low-liquidity periods

It incorporates a time filter (Tm) to restrict trading to specific sessions and a Plus module for enhanced entry/exit management, combining range-breakout logic with session-based trade filtering.
